description: This file defines the OpenDataConversion interface, including its properties, type guards, JSON serialization/deserialization functions, and external dependencies related to data conversion models in an API client.

classes.name: OpenDataConversion
classes.description: Interface representing a data conversion object with properties like id, version, slug, food, amounts, units, source, comment, and creator.

methods.name: instanceOfOpenDataConversion
methods.description: Type guard function to check if an object implements the OpenDataConversion interface.

methods.name: OpenDataConversionFromJSON
methods.description: Deserializes JSON into an OpenDataConversion object.

methods.name: OpenDataConversionFromJSONTyped
methods.description: Deserializes JSON into an OpenDataConversion object with optional discriminator handling.

methods.name: OpenDataConversionToJSON
methods.description: Serializes an OpenDataConversion object into JSON format.
